objective: Integrate the SPS-C04 periodic Gaussian field and self-only versus all-to-all intervention through a separate deterministic aggregation runner with exact matched-stream provenance and schema-valid runtime diagnostics, without running scientific seeds or selecting an eta grid.

inputs.predecessor: SPS-WO-09 conditional analytic and deterministic pass
inputs.active_contrast: self-only aggregation versus all-to-all arithmetic averaging under the same nonzero periodic Gaussian field
inputs.field_contract: YAML contains only serializable correlation_length, component_variance, and max_frequency; reset derives one integer field seed from the dedicated field stream and separately samples fingerprint-identical immutable realizations across arms
inputs.observation_contract: do not add particle IDs, field state, future noise, teammate messages, or diagnostic-only values to LocalObservation; include_teammates must be false
inputs.legacy_runner_contract: the existing null-versus-signal runner semantics and its old artifact schemas must remain unchanged

expected_artifacts: strict serializable periodic-field config and reset integration
separate aggregation-pair runner preserving the legacy null-signal runner
exact initial-state, Brownian-tensor, field-realization, policy-randomness, and event-key provenance checks
schema-valid per-step raw preclip summaries, sent and received messages, valid IDs/counts, fallback, action, yield, geometry, clipping, reflection, and empty-summary diagnostics
schema validator support for every numeric bound used by the diagnostic contracts
conditional finite-sensing B, overlap-error Omega, and estimator-risk D diagnostics with signal-strength scaling on analytically eligible rows
selected-particle diagnostic IDs reconstructed without changing agent observations
zero-intervention identity and deliberate intervention-divergence microcases
configuration, environment, runner, schema, and regression tests
verification_command: PYTHONPATH=/tmp/sps-wo09-testdeps:src:. python -m unittest tests.test_fields tests.test_communication tests.test_policies tests.test_environment tests.test_runner tests.test_aggregation_runner tests.test_schemas tests.test_coordination tests.test_io -v

required_gates.field_reset: same scenario seed and serializable field config produce byte-identical immutable field realizations and fingerprints across arms
required_gates.causal_contrast: aggregation_mode is the sole structural/config difference and both arms use the same encoder, decoder, action bounds, and stochastic inputs; sent messages must be byte-identical only at reset/pre-divergence or in forced-identical-state microcases, while later differences are legitimate causal descendants
required_gates.stream_pairing: initial state, complete Brownian tensor, field realization, policy randomness, and event-key definition are hash-identical
required_gates.information_boundary: diagnostic IDs and latent velocities are never added to LocalObservation or consumed by the controller
required_gates.runtime_diagnostics: every emitted row links the 0-based pre-action decision step to the 1-based post-transition outcome step and validates raw preclip summaries, exact valid IDs/counts, own-empty, fallback, cross-agent rescue, zero-direction cancellation, clipped components, source positions, true scaled local summaries, particle and collector reflection, pre/post collector geometry, valid-set overlap, action similarity, realized displacement, action-implied targets under one frozen deterministic definition, and cumulative unique yield; summaries preserve raw numerators and denominators
required_gates.theory_mapping: for decision step t>=1, B is computed from stable IDs selected at state t but their retained source positions immediately before transition t-1 to t and is scaled by signal_strength squared; Omega uses diffusion_sigma squared over dt and exact set overlap only when every set is nonempty and particle reflection, clipping, and fallback do not invalidate the row; step zero and all other ineligible rows emit null B/Omega/D plus explicit reasons
required_gates.legacy_regression: all established tests pass and legacy null-versus-signal conditions and schemas retain their meaning
required_gates.zero_identity: when both arms are forced to the same aggregation mode, all state, action, event, and diagnostic rows are identical apart from arm labels
required_gates.artifact_safety: all schemas validate before immutable writes and every destination collision is rejected before simulation begins

stop_conditions: any scientific or performance seed is requested
any eta grid point, effect threshold, seed budget, or inferential rule is selected
the unresolved T=1.34 versus canonical horizon-times-dt=8.0 endpoint conflict is silently resolved or changed
the new runner reuses null-versus-signal labels for aggregation arms
particle IDs or latent field values enter LocalObservation or controller inputs
the arms differ in field realization, Brownian noise, initial state, tie-key definition, encoder, decoder, or action limits
runtime diagnostics cannot distinguish clipping, reflection, empty-summary fallback, and moving geometry
an established test or immutable legacy schema regresses
fallback_task: Record the failed integration gate, keep SPS-C04 unsupported, and repair deterministic provenance or schema coverage without running seeds.
positive_interpretation: Permit a separate outcome-blind preregistration design step; this work order cannot freeze a grid or support SPS-C04.
null_interpretation: Repair or redesign the integration before any scientific compute.
reversed_interpretation: Not applicable: WO-10 contains no scientific outcome contrast.

gate_outcome.field_reset: pass: serializable parameters produce fingerprint-identical immutable realizations across arms
gate_outcome.causal_contrast: pass: a separate aggregation runner changes only aggregation mode structurally and preserves one encoder/decoder path
gate_outcome.stream_pairing: pass: initialization, Brownian tensor, field, policy randomness, scenario seed, and event-key provenance match
gate_outcome.information_boundary: pass: stable IDs and latent/source-time diagnostics remain outside LocalObservation and controller inputs
gate_outcome.runtime_diagnostics: pass: schema-valid message, geometry, nonlinear-event, covariance, action, event, and yield rows
gate_outcome.legacy_regression: pass: frozen command 74 tests; full available suite 171 passed and 5 optional PyTorch skips
gate_outcome.zero_identity: pass: same-mode states, observations, actions, events, and diagnostics are identical apart from arm labels
gate_outcome.scientific_claim: unsupported; zero scientific episodes and no grid, endpoint, threshold, seed budget, or inference selected

scientific_status: completed deterministic integration gate; literature, endpoint, and nonlinear-incidence design blockers remain; no scientific episodes
